rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual word for the belly or stomach area, especially in everyday physical contexts.

example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tou5 zung6 tung3 gan2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the digestive organ rather than the whole belly area.

example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 wai6 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this for appetite or a taste for food and, by extension, other things.

example.english: I don't have much stomach for food today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 taai3 jit6 ngo5 mou5 mat1 wai6 hau2

rows.note: Use this for the inclination or willingness to undertake something, as in having no heart for a fight.

example.english: I don't have the stomach to argue with anyone today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 sam1 gei1 tung4 jan4 aau2
